description: OpenTelemetry logs and metrics over OTLP for ASP.NET Core applications, configured only through the standard OTEL_* environment variables. No traces, nothing exported without an endpoint, optional redaction of secrets before export.

Declarative HTTP clients for .NET: annotate an interface, get an implementation at compile time. Includes the source generator, the request runtime, dependency-injection wiring, and the HttpClient transport.
RestSharp transport for Runax.Http. Lets a Runax.Http client interface run over RestSharp instead of HttpClient, selected by name at registration or per call.
Test support for Runax.Http: a recording transport and a harness that stands up a generated client without a socket, so you can assert on the request your client would have sent.
Attributes and transport-neutral contracts for Runax.Http. Reference this from client interfaces and from transport implementations — it depends on no HTTP library and no DI container.
MCP server that gives AI agents a persistent, project-aware F# Interactive session: load a project with its full dependency closure, evaluate code against live state, type-check without running.
